key_findings: TUT-005 (SCH-002, paraprofessional) has the lowest student attendance rate at approximately 76.4%, which is 4.5 percentage points below the program-wide rate of 80.9%.
TUT-005 leads two groups: GRP-007 (math, grade 3, 73.96%) and GRP-010 (reading, grade 6, 78.82%). GRP-007 is the lowest-attending group in the program.
The attendance gap signals that TUT-005 is the highest-priority tutor for operational coaching and targeted support this quarter.
limitations: Attendance rate alone does not establish the root cause of the gap; session cancellations, student factors, or scheduling issues may contribute alongside tutor-specific factors.
The assessment is based on a single quarter of data for a paraprofessional role, which may carry different structural constraints than certified-teacher roles.
